# apple_submit_app_custom_product_page (Action)

Submits a custom product page's version being prepared to App Review, by adding it to the platform's review submission that is being prepared, or a new one. The version needs a localization. Once approved, the version replaces the page's current one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_submit_app_custom_product_page" "summer" {
  config {
    app_id                 = data.apple_app.example.id
    custom_product_page_id = apple_app_custom_product_page.summer.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `custom_product_page_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the custom product page, e.g. `apple_app_custom_product_page.example.id`.

### Optional

- `platform` (String) Platform of the review submission: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS`, `VISION_OS`. Defaults to `IOS`.
- `submit` (Boolean) Whether to submit the review submission. Set it to `false` to add other items to the same submission. Defaults to `true`.
